title: Sicilienne
identity: Groth Music lists Sherwood Shaffer’s Sicilienne as DORN1403 for alto or baritone saxophone and piano. Hays’s 2007 UNCG dissertation describes a single-movement five-minute work composed in 1991, with two versions for saxophone-family pairs; whether DORN1403 matches one particular version is unresolved.

evidence.claim: University repository record identifies Andrew Paul Hays’s 2007 dissertation, A Performer’s Guide to the Saxophone Music of Sherwood Shaffer, and its scope.

The indexed dissertation passage identifies Sicilienne (1991) as a single-movement, approximately five-minute work for alto/baritone or soprano/tenor saxophone and piano. Hays reports that saxophone professors requested a work for less advanced students and that Shaffer composed two versions; exact edition relationship is unresolved. The dissertation PDF link returned 403, so this passage is search-index evidence, not visually verified notation.
